info.name: paccradle API: capture results and corrections (2026-10-30)
info.description:
Change: M1-D5, captures endpoints (2026-10-30). The client contract moves to **1.0.0-beta.4** (`api-version`); the admin contract stays at 1.0.0-beta.2. Merge into the main contract.

**New:** `GET /api/client/v1/captures/{capture_id}` and `POST /api/client/v1/captures/{capture_id}/correct`. **Changed:** `POST /captures` (beta.3) now queues the capture's first vision run with it; its 201 is unchanged. Its settings are checked against vision's own ranges (same messages). `RATE_LIMIT_UPLOADS_PER_HOUR` now counts taps too.

**New codes:** `CAPTURE_PAPER_NOT_FOUND`, `CAPTURE_PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND`, `CAPTURE_TRACE_NOT_FOUND`, `CAPTURE_NOTHING_AT_TAP` (these four are a run's stored errors, 422 if ever answered), `CAPTURE_OUTLINE_CROSSES_ITSELF` (400), `CAPTURE_PROCESSING_FAILED` (500, stored), `CAPTURE_NOT_FOUND` (404), `CAPTURE_PHOTO_DELETED` (410), `CAPTURE_NOT_READY` (409). `CAPTURE_INVALID_INPUT` can now name `tap_point_px`, `edited_contour_px` or `height_mm`.

**Editor flow:** upload → poll GET until not `pending` → draw `result.products[].contour_px` over `photo.url` → on a wrong outline, tap (202, poll again) or drag the points (edit, 200) → type the height (200). Warnings and errors are codes to translate (DEC-11).

request.description:
The caller's capture. Poll it (every second or so) while `status` is `pending`: a vision run takes about a second once it starts.

- `status`: `pending` (a run is queued or running), `done`, `failed` (see `error`).
- `result`: the latest outline, CLAUDE.md §5.5 (paper corners, products with `contour_mm` and `contour_px` in photo pixels, `warnings` as codes, `camera`, `level_used`). It stays while a newer run is pending and after a run fails, so the editor can keep showing it; `null` until the first run succeeds.
- `error`: the last run's failure in the caller's language, with `code` to branch on and `meta` for your own text. Codes: `CAPTURE_PAPER_NOT_FOUND`, `CAPTURE_PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND`, `CAPTURE_TRACE_NOT_FOUND`, `CAPTURE_NOTHING_AT_TAP`, `CAPTURE_INVALID_INPUT` (a tap outside the photo), `CAPTURE_PHOTO_DELETED`, `CAPTURE_PROCESSING_FAILED`.
- `photo.url`: a signed link that works until `url_expires_at` (10 minutes); fetch the capture again for a new one. `null` once the photo was deleted (30 days, `photo_kept_until`).

Someone else's capture, or an unknown id, is `CAPTURE_NOT_FOUND`. Answers are `no-store`.

response.name: 200 pending (first run queued)

request.description: A tap on the product, in photo pixels (the frame of `contour_px` and `corners_px`): detection runs again and keeps the outline under the tap, or the nearest within 10 mm. **202**, `status: pending`; poll `GET /captures/{capture_id}`. The last outline stays until the run lands. Works after `CAPTURE_PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND` too. Counts against `RATE_LIMIT_UPLOADS_PER_HOUR` with uploads. Without a tap, a retry would give the same outline (until L2 in M3): offer a tap, Trace mode or an edit.

request.description: The outline as the user drew it, in photo pixels, in order round the product (3 to 2,000 points). Measured exactly as drawn, at once: **200**, `contour_source: user`, confidence 1. Outdates any pending run. Needs an outline (`CAPTURE_NOT_READY` otherwise); a crossing outline is `CAPTURE_OUTLINE_CROSSES_ITSELF`; points off the paper or under 25 mm² are `CAPTURE_INVALID_INPUT` (`meta.field = edited_contour_px`).

response.name: 200 measured as drawn

request.description: The product's height in mm (0.1 to 1000), typed by the user. Kept for every later run and applied to the outline at once: **200**, with the tall-product warning worked out again (`outline_may_be_bigger` with `up_to_mm`, or none when under 0.5 mm). While a run is still pending, a new run with the height is queued instead: **202**.
